comment: The article presents a balanced view of the climate initiative without overtly favoring either side and includes perspectives from both sides: Simone de Montmollin (left-leaning) criticizes the proposed fund for being potentially burdensome on future generations due to its potential impact on national debt, while also highlighting existing efforts.
